from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentExtract(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) stated in the document")
    document_category: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal category of the document (e.g., Administrative, Civil)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentExtract]
